Strategy: Scaled narrow awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between half the item and the full item lose a penalty of half the item, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that narrow awkward band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by targeting only the most awkward leftovers, but may fail if the band is too narrow to matter.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item / 2 if r - item > item / 2 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Scaled narrow awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/2, item] by item/2, exact fit highest.
